title: Scale Inversion — From Mundane Trigger to Cosmic Structure
purpose: Formalize a repeated Potatoverse move: begin with something extremely small, ordinary or ridiculous, follow its relationships outward, and use it as a lens for larger psychological, cultural, theological or systems structures.
core_pattern: tiny trigger → relation → repeated pattern → system → symbolic/cosmic synthesis → return to evidence

seed → death/burial → multiplication → Son/Christ comparison → harvest

ordinary frustration → last-straw/threshold → April-2025 Turning in later chronology
examples.boundary: The ordinary event can be a narrative hinge without proving a supernatural causal mechanism.

epistemic_guardrail: A useful metaphorical scaling path is not empirical proof that the tiny object causes, contains or validates the entire external system. The project should store each edge separately: observable property, Timic interpretation, comparative tradition, later archive synthesis.
why_it_matters: This is both a content motif and a research method. It explains why seemingly throwaway Tim remarks can later become important when their relational neighborhood is reconstructed.
archive_workflow: promote only stable relations into canonical ontology
deep_findings: The Potatoverse repeatedly treats low status and small scale as information-rich rather than insignificant.
Humor can function as compression: ridiculous language sometimes carries multiple serious relations beneath it.
Scale inversion helps explain why mundane biography and maximal theology are intentionally adjacent rather than separate genres.
The best archive implementation is zoomable: a reader can start with one potato, quote, meme or date and expand outward through relations into the whole graph.
